question_cn: 2026 世界杯小组赛 J 组：阿根廷 vs 阿尔及利亚（90 分钟三路赛果）？
question_en: 2026 World Cup Group J: Argentina vs Algeria (three-way 90-minute result)?
one_liner_cn: 阿根廷 Elo 高出 343 分且近 5 战全胜，模型给约七成胜率；因多名主力带伤及阿尔及利亚刚 1-0 胜荷兰，小幅下调至 69.5%。
one_liner_en: Argentina's 343-point Elo edge and five straight wins put them near 70%; nudged down to 69.5% for squad knocks and Algeria's recent 1-0 win over the Netherlands.

key_reasons.cn: Elo 差距 343 分（阿根廷 2115 vs 阿尔及利亚 1772），Davidson 统计模型基线即给阿根廷约 71% 胜率。
key_reasons.en: A 343-point Elo gap (Argentina 2115 vs Algeria 1772) gives Argentina about a 71% baseline win probability in the Davidson model.

key_reasons.cn: 阿根廷近 5 场全胜（进 15 失 1）、梅西近 6 场首发 6 球，但 Balerdi 退队、两右后卫与 Paredes 带伤、门将手指骨折，伤情构成小幅减分。
key_reasons.en: Argentina won their last five (15:1 goals) with Messi scoring in six straight starts, but Balerdi is out and several starters carry knocks — a small downgrade.

key_reasons.cn: 阿尔及利亚 6 月 3 日热身 1-0 击败荷兰，显示对强队的防守组织力；但中场核心 Bennacer 落选名单。
key_reasons.en: Algeria beat the Netherlands 1-0 on June 3, showing defensive organization against elite sides, though midfielder Bennacer was left out of the squad.

method_note: Market-blind: Davidson three-way Elo model (scale=400, drawNu=0.7, neutral venue, no host bonus) gave 71.45/18.63/9.92; bounded evidence adjustment of ~2pp off Argentina for squad injuries and Algeria's Netherlands result, renormalized. Independent of all betting/prediction-market data.
